title: Junior Python Backend Developer
description: We are seeking an entry-level Python backend developer to join our engineering team. You will write clean code, work with Flask, build REST APIs, and gain hands-on experience with SQL databases. Remote positions available. Ideal for recent graduates or self-taught developers with basic coding projects in Python.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Architect
description: Looking for a seasoned leader with 10+ years of production experience designing and deploying large scale AI systems. Must have a PhD in Computer Science or related quantitative field, deep knowledge of CUDA, LLM training loops, PyTorch, and a track record of leading teams of 15+ research scientists. Non-remote, on-site.

title: React and TypeScript Frontend Intern
description: Seeking a passionate frontend intern. You will help build responsive user interfaces using React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript. Some experience with basic coding is helpful. However, this is a purely client-facing frontend UI internship, no backend coding or Python is involved.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Entry-level data engineer role focused on Python, SQL, ETL pipelines, and data quality checks. You will help maintain Airflow workflows, clean datasets, and support analytics teams. Remote-friendly and open to recent graduates.

title: Site Reliability Engineer I
description: We are hiring an SRE to help operate Kubernetes clusters, automate deployments, improve observability, and support incident response. This is an early-career role with mentoring and strong interest in Python scripting, Linux, and cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior Frontend Engineering Manager
description: Leadership role managing a frontend organization. Requires 8+ years of experience, prior people management, and deep ownership of design systems and roadmap execution. Not suitable for junior candidates.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
description: Internship focused on building data pipelines, training small ML models, and evaluating embeddings. Strong Python skills and curiosity about AI systems are important. Remote applicants welcome.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description: Join a small product team building APIs in Python and Flask with PostgreSQL, background jobs, and cloud deployments. We prefer candidates with shipped projects and a willingness to learn rather than years of experience. Remote-first.

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description: Principal-level platform role requiring deep systems design experience, cross-team technical leadership, and 8+ years in production engineering. Not an entry-level opportunity.
